description: Monthly dependency policy shared by every active project.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates share one PR and merge themselves once CI is green. A repo without CI reports no checks, so its PR waits for a person.
A major update is a migration: its own PR, never merged automatically.
Python 3.x to 3.y removes stdlib APIs. Renovate calls it minor; treat it as major. It needs its own group, because one non-automerge update stops the whole group from merging.
A Postgres major needs a dump and restore of the data directory, so it waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
Wait a week after a registry release: hijacked packages are usually caught and pulled within days. Registries only; Docker tags often lack a release timestamp and would never update.
